summary: Check the conflicting person markers in the dog example
rationale: The translation is ich hetzte den Hund auf ihn. The form mharkašli agrees with ich, but aʕli denotes auf mich, as the adjacent detransitive example itself confirms. If the translation is retained, aʕle would match auf ihn; alternatively mharkašle could match er hetzte ... auf mich. No grammar-page source text is supplied to decide which side is corrupt.
Here man is the noun Mann, the subject of stürzte, and is misspelled with one n and lowercase.
